title: Investigate a boundary condition
description: Design a small C# experiment to investigate a comparison at a chosen threshold. Predict behavior below, at, and above the threshold, then explain how changing the comparison affects the boundary. Write the experiment yourself.
hints: What should happen when the input equals the threshold?
Test a value on each side of the threshold before testing equality.
Strict and inclusive comparisons differ at equality. Boundary inputs help reveal a mismatch between intended behavior and a condition.
Investigation outline: describe the intended rule; list boundary inputs; predict outcomes; run your experiment; compare evidence with the rule.
